tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bla ma drag po kī la ya'i man ngag bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// snang mtha' spyan ras gzigs dang pad+ma 'byung*// chos longs sprul pa'i skur bzhengs grags pa'i gzhi'i// zhabs zung byang chub snying po de tshun du// bdag gi spyi bo'i nor bu nyid gyur cig/ de'ang gnyal yangs pa can zhes pa'i grong khyer chen po'i dbus/ dpal gyi ri bo'i ngogs rdo rje gdan gyi gtsug lag khang du kho bo slebs pa'i skabs shig mtshan mo'i thun tha ma rdzogs te/ skya rengs 'char ka tsam la gnyid thum du song ba'i rmi lam du srin yul rnga yab gling nas slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis brdzangs pa'i pho nya ba srin po gdong gcig pa/ mdog smug nag na ra'i g.yang gzhis smad dkris shing*/ mi mgo ya mgal gcig thod du bcings pa gnyis byung nas slob dpon chen po'i bka' las khyod la da lor dam sri spun dgu'i bar chad che bar 'dug pas/ gdams pa 'di nyams su longs dang*/ des bzlog par 'gyur la/ phyis kyang de bzhin byed na bar chad las rgyal bar 'gyur ro// zhes bka' stsal brgyur te log go snyam sems pa'i mod de khar rang gi mdun gyi nam mkha'i snam logs g.yon du nye ba'i thad na rig 'dzin chen po drag po rtsal stod khro rgyal smad phur pa'i dbyibs 'chad par 'gyur ba ji lta ba/ sku'i rgyan dang sngags phyag rgya mi sgrib cing drag po'i sngags sgra dang bcas pa mthong ba'i mod la zil gyis brgyal ba snyam byed pa zhig byung ste mthar rang yal lo// sad nas rig 'dzin chen pos bdag la byin rlabs 'pho ba'i dbang bskur ba yin no snyam dga' mgu rangs pa bsam gyis mi khyab bo// bka' stsal ji ltar bsgyur ba'i snying po ni 'di'o// rdzogs pa chen po'i klong nyid las/ dran rig 'di ka drag po'i sku// rdo rje phur pa'i gzugs su ni// chu las chu bur brdol ltar bskyed// rgyan dang sprul pa ji lta ba// yas la kā ste mas la ā// dmod pa'i mtshon cha bar du ltems// tsit+ta'i gur khyim phyag rgya bca'// phyogs bcu'i zhing nas spyan drangs bstim// re res gzi brjid 'bum du gyur// rigs lngar gsol btab dbang bskur blang*// oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te badz+ra kī li kī la ya/

zhes bzlas dgug gzhug yang yang bya/ stod las so// khro bcu'i dregs pa des gnod byed// bcing ba lngas bcings brub khung bcug /ye shes rang bstim 'jig rten pa// gzir bas lha phral phur pas bsgral// che ge mo trig nan/ che ge mo'i snying la hur thum dzaḥ gzir ba'o// bsgral ba ni/ gnod byed dgra'am bgegs thams cad mā ra ya ste/ gnyis ka sngags kyi sham bur bya'o// pad+ma nga yi snying thig ste// bsnyen sgrub las sbyor chig dril yin// srung zlog bsad las mthar thug pas// skal ldan snying gi dkyil du sbos// sa ma ya/ dam tshig gi rgya'o// da ni de'i don slob dpon nyid kyi byin rlabs kyis rnyed pa ni/ bde ba'i stan la 'dug ste/ rnal 'byor gyi yo byad mdun du bshams te/ bar chad kyi gdon bgegs dgra bo thams cad bsgral te byang chub chen po bsgrub par bya'o snyam pas/ bdag ni mgon po gzhan spangs nas// rig 'dzin chen po khyod la skyabs// de ci'i slad du zhe na khyod// sangs rgyas chos tshogs kun lags so// de phyir thugs rje'i spyan ras kyis// rnam pa kun tu gzigs pa dang*// khyod kyis mdzad pa gang lags pa// de la bdag gis bslab par bgyi// zhes sems bskyed/ oṃ swa bhā wa bi shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa bi shud+dhau3haṃ/ ye dag ye rdzogs chen po'i klong*/ dran rig ye shes kyi cha/ rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma drag po rtsal bskal pa'i me'i bong dang mdangs dang gzi brjid 'dzin pa/ zhal gnam sa tsam du gdangs shing mche ba gangs ri ltar gtsigs pa/ mid pa stong gsum tsam brgyangs pa'i ya rkan la nyi ma kā lis mtshan pa/ ma mgal la zla ba ā lis mtshan pa/ ljags kyi rtse rta gdong gi me lce lta bur bskyod pa'i rtsa bar hūm̐ la oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te badz+ra kī li kī la ya/ zhes pa'i yig 'bru dmar po 'brug stong dus gcig tu ldir ba lta bu'i sgra grags bzhin pas bskor ba/

dmar ba'i spyan gsum pa/ phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa nam mkhar 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon sprul pa'i lcags sdig mgo dgu rwa bco brgyad pa bsnams pas gdug pa can thams cad gzir ba/ dpal gyi chas kyis legs par brgyan pa sku smad chu srin khros pa'i kha nas gnam lcags 'bar ba'i phur bu dbal gsum rtse mo gcig tu rno ba/ nang khong seng can/ dpral bar 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed gser mdog can g.yas ral gri 'phyar ba/ mgrin par rta mgrin dmar po g.yas dbyug tho 'phyar ba/ brang dbus kyi thad kyi nang du dregs pa phyag na rdo rje sngon po g.yas rdo rje 'phyar ba/ gsang gnas su khro bo yak+ṣa me dbal smug nag g.yas tho ba 'phyar ba/ de thams cad g.yon thugs kar sdig mdzub/ shin tu khro la dpal gyi chas kyis brgyan cing*/ g.yon brkyang gis gnas pa/ lte bar rdo rje phag mo dmar mo g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thugs kar thod khrag 'dzin pa gcer mo chags pa rgyas pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs can/ thod kyi mgo bo rnams kyi dbus ma la bud+dha thod phreng rtsal g.yas su rdo rje thod phreng rtsal dang rat+na thod phreng rtsal/ g.yon du pad+ma thod phreng rtsal dang karma thod phreng rtsal/ dkar sngo ser dmar ljang ba/ thams cad zhi ma khro za 'og smug po'i ber/ lhub gyon du mdzad cing rus pa dang rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dbu la sha ba'i snyan zhu rgod kyi rtse 'phru dar gyi cod pan 'phur ba gsol zhing phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin pa/ g.yon thod khrag dkur brten pas rang rigs kyi yum gcer mo phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa la 'khyud de rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ 'khor mkha' 'gro bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba/ mtshog mar sprul pa'i khyung mthing nag gdug pa can gyi klu zas su za ba/ spyi bo'i bu gar gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba/ mig sna rna ba kha lte ba brgyad du rnam rgyal/

gshin rje gshed/ rta mgrin/ bgegs mthar byed/ dbyug sngon can/ mi g.yo ba/ 'dod rgyal/ stobs po che/ phur pa'i dbal gyi nang rtser gnod mdzes thams cad khro bo'i chas can lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon brkyang thams cad mthing ga tsit+ta rin po che'i gur khyim du zla ba la gser gyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa 'ja' 'od sna lnga'i dbus na gnas pa/ de'i gnas so so'i lha las 'od 'phros rnga yab gling gi pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal med khang sogs phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na slob dpon chen po'i sku gsung thugs kyi dkon mchog gsum du rnam par rol pa thams cad spyan drangs par gyur par bsam te/ hūm̐/ 'di nas nyi ma lho nub mtshams shed na// o rgyan sprul sku'i zhing khams rnga yab gling*// rāk+sha mi zan rnams kyi rgyal po'i khab// dpal ri pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang dang*// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i zhing khams thams cad nas// sku gsung thugs kyi rnam 'gyur mi zad pa'i// rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas la// gsang ba'i mtshan gsol gu ru drag po rtsal// ma rungs gdug pa 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol// rnal 'byor bar chad sel phyir gshegs su gsol// dad ldan byin gyis rlob phyir gshegs su gsol// dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol phyir gshegs su gsol// zhes spyan drangs nas/ slob dpon chen po'i sku rgyal ba zhi khro'i sangs rgyas thams cad du snang ba/ gsung gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags thams cad du grags pa'i yig 'bru dmar po/ thugs ting nge 'dzin phyag rgya thams cad du 'char ba/ steng nas char babs pa lta bu/ 'og nas sa rlangs thon pa lta bu/ bar nas bu yug 'tshubs pa lta bur nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang thams cad mer mer yom yom shig shig byon nas bdag gi lus lhar gsal ba dang*/ ngag sngags su gsal ba dang*/ yid phyag rgyar gsal ba la rim rim thim par bsam te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te badz+ra kī li kī la ya/

kā ya sid+dhi oṃ/ wak+ka sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐/ zhes dzab nyer gcig gam bdun cis kyang bzla'o// de nas dbang sgrub lha lnga la gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba 'di ltar gdab ste/ kye/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i rje// 'od gsal lhun grub skye 'gro yongs kyi mgon// skye 'chi med pa rdo rje lta bu'i sku// mnyam pa med pa'i che mchog he ru ka /'gro mgon bla ma khyed la skyabs su mchi// gsol ba 'debs so gu ru rin po che// thugs rjes gzigs shig o rgyan sprul pa'i sku// bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// de bzhin tshig rkang dang po dang*/ bzhi pa 'don pa cung zad bsgyur ba rigs lnga ka la shes par bya ste/ sku mchog 'gyur med bud+dha thod phreng rtsal// zhes dang*/ mnyam pa med pa'i bud+dha he ru ka / zhes dang*/ gsung mchog 'gag med pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// zhes dang*/ mnyam pa med pa'i pad+ma he ru ka /thugs mchog dri med badz+ra thod phreng rtsal// zhes dang*/ mnyam pa med pa'i badz+ra he ru ka / yon tan kun rdzogs rat+na thod phreng rtsal/ zhes dang*/ mnyam pa med pa'i rat+na he ru ka /phrin las thogs med karma thod phreng rtsal/ zhes dang*/ mnyam pa med pa'i karma he ru ka / de nas/ dbang sgrub kyi lha tshogs thams cad snyoms par zhugs pas bde ba rgyas te sbyor mtshams nas byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar 'dres pa dpag tu med pa babs/ bdag gis spyi bo nas bye ma la chu btab pa lta bur zhugs/ spyi bo gang*/ lus kyi dri ma dag bum pa'i dbang thob/ mgrin pa gang*/ ngag gi dri ma dag gsang ba'i dbang thob/ snying ga gang*/ yid kyi dri ma dag dbang gsum pa thob/ lte ba gang*/ sgo gsum tha dad du 'dzin pa'i dri ma dag dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus thams cad gang ba'i rgyun spyi bor lud pas ral pa gyen du brdzes pa'i dbus su snang ba mtha' yas mchog gi sprul pa'i sku'i cha lugs can du gyur

par bsam te bskyed rim la ji srid mi skyo'i bar du bsgom/ skyo na/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te badz+ra kī li kī la ya/ zhes pa bzla/ de la skyo na sngar bzhin sku gsung thugs kyi lha tshogs spyan drangs shing bstim pa yang yang bya/ bstim theb re re la lus gzi brjid/ ngag nus pa/ sems ting nge 'dzin rtsal je cher 'gro bar bsam mo// 'di ni stod las su bzhag ste byang chub sgrub pa'i lam ngo ma'o// de nas/ rang gi 'og tu brub khung lcags bsregs kyi khang sgrom nag la gting ring ba zhig tu bsam/ khro bo bcus sde brgyad dregs pa can rnams bkug de dag gzir bas bdag gi bran du khas blangs par bsam la/ yid a ya ma du ru tsa sha na phyung ste phral/ lus bdag gis ci bsgo ba'i las byed par bsam la/ de nas/ de dag gis bdag la snga dgra lag la bdar ba/ da dgra dngos su byed pa/ phyi dgra yid la sems pa/ thog tu 'gel nus pa'i gnod byed gdon bgegs dgra ci yod pa thams cad lcags kyus rang dbang bral bar bkug zhags pas lus bcings/ nus pas ngag ting nge 'dzin gyis sems/ mthu rtsal gyis skyob byed lha thams cad bcings nas gshed mas btson khrid pa bzhin brub khung du bcug de la rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bur 'phros pas srung ba bral/ 'das pa'i skyob byed bsdus nas bdag la bstim/ 'jig rten pa'i lha snying po'i mthar ngos zin na de ka'i ming ngam gnas srog ma zin na trig nan snying la hur thum dzaḥ zhes gzir bas skyob byed de brgyal zhing 'bog nas dran pa nyams/ de nas rtsa ba'i sham bur gnod byed thams cad mā ra ya zhes bcug pas/ bdag nyid rdo rje phur par gsal ba de nam mkha' la 'gying zhing bsgril bas/ nyams pa de gzir bas khab len dang 'phrad pa'i lcags bzhin tshe rten 'byung ba'i dwangs ma a/ srog rten rnam shes nṛ'i rnam par gnas pa de so so'i spyi bo nas thon phur pa'i dbal du zhugs pas tshe rten bdag la thim/

srog rten rdo rje phag mo'i bha ga'i rdul gyis dug gsum bkrus pas hūm̐ ye shes kyi rang bzhin de nyid kyi bha gar sangs rgyas/ rdo rje phur pa drag po'i thog lhung ba ltar de dag gi snying gar babs pas mar la lcags bsregs bsur ba lta bur tshir tshir zhu zhing khol/ gzhob tu thu lu lu tshig pa'i mthar rdul tsam yang mi dmigs par bsam te/ rdzogs pa chen po'i klong du mnyam par gzhag langs pa'i dus dge ba bsngo/ tshes bcu la sogs pa'i tshe mchod pa dang*/ gzhan rjes su 'dzin na/ gtor ma la tsakli btsug pa sku rten/ thod par bdud rtsi a mṛ ta gsung rten rdo rje rtse dgu thugs rten/ bum pa yon tan/ nya bo sde brgyad kyi gtor ma/ rdo rje phur pa dang bcas pa phrin las kye rten du bshams/ mchod rdzas tshogs gter gyis mtha' bskor/ bdag bskyed byas nas mdun bskyed sku rten drag po rgyan bcas/ gsung rten nyi zla ga'u kha sbyor gyi dbus su sngags phreng*/ thugs rten zla ba rdo rje/ bum pa dbang sgrub lha lnga/ phur pa'ang drag po rgyan can du bskyed/ spyan drangs so sor bstim/ lha rdzas me tog kun gyis nam mkha' bkang*// dri zhim bdug spos bsreg pas sa gzhi bkang*// snang gsal 'od zer phyogs bcu'i mthar 'brel ba// rig 'dzin chen po khyod la mchod par 'bul// sim skyed bdud rtsi byugs pa'i chu 'dzin g.yos// bda' dgu'i zhal zas thams cad char du babs// snyan pa'i 'brug sgra 'ur 'ur sgrog pa rnams// rig 'dzin chen po khyod la mchod par 'bul// mdzes mas bro brdungs snyan pa'i glu blangs mthar// dri zhim ngad 'gyed ma mchu'i sbrang sbyin nas// reg mthar bde ba bha gas stob pa rnams// rig 'dzin chen po khyed la mchod par 'bul// myos byed dpa' bo'i dam rdzas phud chen 'thor// snang srid ma mo'i mchod rdzas rak+ta sgreng*// thun mongs mnyes pa'i ba liṃ cher bshams pa// rig 'dzin chen po khyod la mchod par 'bul//

de nas bstod pa ni/ snang ba mtha' yas sku yi 'phro 'du las// bde gshegs 'dus pa'i khro rgyal drag po rtsal// ma rungs gdug pa 'dul ba'i phrin las pa// khyod la bstod do lus la byin gyis rlobs// snang ba mtha' yas gsung gi 'phro 'du las// gsang ba 'dus pa'i sngags rgod dmod pa'i mtshon// ma rungs gdug pa 'dul ba'i phrin las pa// khyod la bstod do ngag la byin gyis rlobs// snang ba mtha' yas thugs kyi 'phro 'du las// sor rtog ye shes rdzogs pa chen po'i klong*// ma rungs gdug pa 'dul ba'i phrin las pa// khyod la bstod do yid la byin gyis rlobs// de nas bzlas pas mdun bskyed bskul/ de nas tshogs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ sa byin gyis brlab/ dang po phud kyis mi mchod du// rig 'dzin lha tshogs phud la mnyes// des na phud kyi mchod pa 'di// zag med bdud rtsi bsam nas 'bul// bar du tshogs kyis mi mchod du// ma dang mkha' 'gro tshogs la mnyes// des na tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di// bshags shing skong ba'i rten du 'bul// mtha' mar bsgral bas mi mchod du// chos skyong srung ma baṃ la mnyes// des na tshogs kyi tha ma 'di// dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i rdzas su 'bul//

rgyas par spro na gsol 'debs kyi mthar/ tshogs rdzas 'di la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes bsgyur/ de nas gzhan la byin rlabs byed na/ khrus bya/ bgegs gtor gtang*/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ bla ma rig 'dzin chen po drag po rtsal du mos la/ lus la brtul zhugs gzi brjid bskyed du gsol// ngag la nus pa'i byin rlabs sbar du gsol// sems la rtogs pa'i ye shes bskyed du gsol// lus ngag yid gsum smin par mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab/ bla mas slob ma'i lus lha/ ngag sngags/ yid phyag rgya bca' ba rnams gong bzhin brjod/ spyan drangs pa nam mkhar bzhugs par mos la/ bstod pa'i tha mar/ skal ldan lus la gnyis med thim gyur cig gtor tsag gis dbang bskur/ drag po rtsal slob ma'i lus la bstim/ lus la brtul zhugs kyi gzi brjid rgyas/ de nas gzhan 'dra/ skal ldan ngag la gnyis med thim gyur cig thod pas dbang bskur/ gsung sngags kyi tshogs mgrin pa'i sngags la bstim/ ngag la nus pa 'bar/ de nas/ skal ldan yid la gnyis med thim gyur cig rdo rje rtse dgus dbang bskur/ thugs phyag mtshan la bstim pas/ sems la rtogs pa'i ye shes skyes/ de nas spos dang rol mo gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba btab bum pas dbang bskur/ thod phreng rigs lnga snyoms par zhugs pa las/ bde ba rgyas pas byang sems sbyor mtshams lhung*/ spyi bo gang bas lus kyi dri ma dag bum pa'i dbang thob sku yi dngos grub 'grub/ mgrin pa gang bas ngag gi dri ma dag gsang ba'i dbang thob gsung gi dngos grub 'grub/ snying ga gang bas yid kyi dri ma dag shes rab dbang thob thugs kyi dngos grub 'grub/ lte ba gang bas tha dad dri ma dag bzhi pa'i dbang thob rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'grub/ gu ru drag po dang sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las mnyam par bsam/ de nas brub khung mdun du bkod/ dpon slob gnyis kas/ khro bo bcus sde brgyad dregs pa can rnams bkug

nas/ brub khung du bcug gi bar/ de nas/ snang ba mtha' yas thugs rje'i 'phro 'du las// pad+ma dbang gi khro bo'i rgyal po ni// bar chad bgegs 'dul badz+ra kī la ya// gnod byed gdug pa can rnams bsgral bar gyis// drag sngags dzab tu bzla/ phur bskor byed dus dmigs pa lhag par brtan/ dmigs med du mi gtong bar sha khrag dum bu dum bur gtub/ nya bo gtubs nas gtor mar bran te/ de lag tu thogs nas/ rig 'dzin bla ma'i lha tshogs dang*// bka' srung las byed shan pa rnams// phyes shig phyes shig zhal phyes shig /gnam sa tsam gyi zhal gdangs shig /gangs ri tsam gyi mche gtsigs shig /bar snang tsam gyi ljags rkyongs shig /stong gsum tsam gyi mid pa gdangs// dgra bgegs gdug pa bsgral ba'i rdzas// zhal du bstab bo kha raṃ khā hi// zhes brjod cing ling ro nas dum bu re byin la sde brgyad/ gats+tsha sa gshegs/ tshogs la rol/ lhag ma ni/ lhag ma bshal chus mi mchod du// ma sring ma mo lhag la dgyes// kha phrus bran pa'i mchod pa 'di// mthun pa'i rdzas su bsngos nas 'bul// zhes phyir dor ro// 'di ni lha rtse bla ma dge 'dun gyis bskul ba'i ngor dang*/ gzhan mang po la phan pa'i don du bri 'os pa'i mtshan ma mthong nas/ slob dpon pad+ma nyid kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i sngags pa nag po ngag dbang nor bus sbyar ba'o// maṅga laṃ// //
